illustration.description: Full-body anatomical human skeleton standing in a front-facing, symmetrical pose with arms angled slightly outward and palms facing the viewer. Bones are rendered in a warm ivory-beige tone with soft grey shading and fine ink-like contour lines, in a clean semi-realistic medical-illustration style. The ends of the long bones (humerus, forearm, femur, and shin bones near the knees and ankles) glow with bright electric-blue highlights to mark the growth plates. Soft even studio lighting, subtle shadows beneath the bones, plain light background with no text.
